results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy platform, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides.
Lift and place your right foot on the platform, ensuring your entire foot is firm.
Push through your right heel to lift your body onto the bench, bringing your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of reps, then switch to the left leg.
tips: Ensure the bench or platform is stable and secure.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Push through your heel rather than your toes for better glute activation.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Step-Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step your right foot forward and your left foot back, keeping your feet hip-width apart for balance.
Lower your body into a lunge position by bending both knees until your front knee is directly above your ankle and your back knee is hovering just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso upright and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes.
Keep your feet hip-width apart to maintain balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Bend your knees and push your hips back as if you are sitting in a chair, lowering your body into a squat position. Ensure your knees do not extend beyond your toes.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your weight evenly distributed through your heels.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor to maintain stability.
Align your knees with your toes throughout the movement to prevent straining your knees.
Lower yourself in a controlled manner to maintain balance and form.
results.description: Dumbbell Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Squats to Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height just in front of your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand up while simultaneously pressing the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you prepare for the next squat. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes during the squat to avoid unnecessary strain.
Exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead and inhale as you lower into the squat.
Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward during the squat.
results.description: Dumbbell Squats to Shoulder Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Stand with one foot fully planted and place the opposite foot a short step behind, resting on the ball of the foot with the heel raised. Hold a dumbbell in each hand using an overhand grip.
Shift most of your weight onto the front leg, slightly bend both knees, and push your hips backward as you hinge your torso forward.
Lower the dumbbells in front of your shins while keeping your back straight and the weights close to your legs.
Press through your front foot and drive your hips forward to return upright, then complete the repetitions before switching your stance.
tips: Keep most of your body weight on the front leg and use the rear foot mainly for balance.
Push your hips backward rather than lowering into a squat.
Stop lowering when you feel a controlled stretch without rounding your back.
Inhale as you hinge forward and exhale as you return to standing.
results.description: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and hold a dumbbell securely across your hips. Plant one foot close to your hips and place the opposite heel slightly farther forward with the toes raised.
Press primarily through the foot closest to your hips while using the forward heel lightly for balance.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, keeping your hips level.
Pause and squeeze your glutes, then lower your hips with control and complete the repetitions before switching to the other side.
tips: Keep the foot closest to your hips firmly planted throughout the movement.
Use the forward heel mainly for balance rather than pushing equally through both legs.
Drive through the heel and middle of your working foot rather than your toes.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you lift them.
results.description: Dumbbell Staggered Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Staggered Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the edge of a flat bench and hold a dumbbell securely across your hips. Plant one foot close to your hips and place the opposite heel slightly farther forward with the toes raised.
Press primarily through the foot closest to your hips and lift your hips toward the ceiling while using the forward heel lightly for balance.
Continue lifting until your torso and working thigh form a straight line, keeping your hips level and squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips with control, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other side.
tips: Place most of your weight through the foot closest to your hips.
Use the farther heel mainly for balance rather than driving equally through both legs.
Stop at full hip extension without arching your lower back.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you press them upward.
results.description: Dumbbell Staggered Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise on Step
instructions: Stand on a step platform with your heels hanging off the edge, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Position your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through your forefeet, lifting your body upward.
Hold the top position for a brief moment, feeling the contraction in your calf muscles.
Lower your heels below the edge of the step, feeling a stretch in your calves. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the step or platform is stable and secure before starting the exercise.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid bouncing at the top or bottom of the movement.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise on Step is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your posture straight and your core engaged.
Slowly raise your heels off the floor by pushing through your forefeet, lifting your body upward as high as possible.
Hold the top position for a brief moment, feeling the contraction in your calf muscles.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid bouncing at the top or bottom of the movement.
Maintain a straight posture throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and hold a dumbbell against the outside of one thigh with the same-side hand.
Shift your weight onto the opposite leg, engage your core, and keep your supporting knee slightly bent.
Keep your working leg straight and lift it out and upward to the side while maintaining an upright torso and keeping your toes facing forward.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your leg with control and repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting foot firmly planted and distribute your weight across the entire foot.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning away from the working leg.
Avoid swinging your leg or using momentum to raise the dumbbell.
Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core, Obliques.
